# jobrunner

Small job runner with a pluggable, bounded retry policy.

## Retry policy

Configure `RetryConfig` with `max_attempts`, `base_delay_ms`, and
`max_delay_ms`. `max_attempts` is the total number of job calls, including the
first call. A transient error is retried until the attempt budget is exhausted;
a permanent error is returned immediately. Between retries, delays start at
`base_delay_ms`, double after each failed attempt, and saturate at
`max_delay_ms`.

`run_job` accepts a `Sleeper`, so applications can provide a real clock-based
implementation while tests can use the exported `FakeSleeper` to inspect the
requested delays without waiting.
